exposure: Participants vs non-participants in pregnancy classes
outcome: Labor complications (prolonged labor, postpartum hemorrhage, postpartum fever, premature rupture of membrane)
cohort: 194 women aged 20-35 years who gave birth between January and November 2019 in Balarejo sub-district, East Java, Indonesia.
finding: Participation in pregnancy classes was associated with a significantly lower probability of experiencing prolonged labor, postpartum hemorrhage, postpartum fever, and cesarean section.
